maxVersionNote: 0.1.0 (30/10/2026) is Tracy Base 0.5.6 copied as Tracy Coffee, minus the page kinds a coffee shop does not use; src/lib/ds-slot.ts and Logo.astro byte-identical to Base 0.5.6, the theme toggle's stored key renamed tracy-coffee-theme
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: as emdash-base-roles.json: the stylesheets are Base 0.5.6's, which read every standard role variable themselves
modesNote: the light/dark switch of Base 0.5.6 ([data-tracy-theme-toggle] in Header.astro); a choice made under a system is stored under tracy-coffee-theme@<id>

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))

readyNote: measured 30/10/2026 with flow.mjs --cms emdash on a site built from the 0.1.0 source: the 15 featured systems at 1440 and 390, every view matches its system (roles 100%, page follows 100%), every text reads at least as well as on the template, 4 controls 0 differences, the cup keeps its own colours; screenshots read by a person. Measurement: contracts/0.1.0/design-system-measurement.json. On a Docker Desktop bind mount a few steps were served on the second request (~140 ms) instead of the first; re-run alone they pass on the first
